nodes.name: First Warrant
nodes.brief: The Recall Authority has attested three Linewrought roots moving through the ridge pass under foundry marks. Break the militia screen and hold the warrant ground long enough for the custody readers to record the machines. The Tender pays for compliance, not wreckage.

nodes.name: Custody Posts
nodes.brief: Cutbank's two custody posts carry contradictory root rolls written during the Foundry Winter. Take both intact and hold while the Authority resolves them against the Compact archive. The local garrison is fielding rebuilds; every sealed repair remains your own account.

nodes.name: Sarn Inventory
nodes.brief: Sarn Foundry has opened three gates against the attestation node and called every serviceable rebuild in the district. Keep the registry under Tender control until its root list is sealed. Salvage has no standing in the warrant; custody and a solvent company do.

nodes.name: Root Exchange
nodes.brief: The Sarn inventory exposed a relay chain trading service-reader records between foundries. Key the four readers and hold them while the Authority follows each borrowed serial back to its root. Destroying the patrol proves nothing; the copied route is the warrant.

nodes.name: Quarry Receipt
nodes.brief: Blackglass Quarry is cutting counterfeit serial plates from condemned castings and matching them to the exchanged records. Seize the weigh ledger, lift manifest and serial punch, then preserve them for civil proof. The Tender cannot attest fragments.

nodes.name: Conduit Injunction
nodes.brief: The quarry receipts lead to a live rebuild conduit under a disputed service injunction. Hold its breaker while the custody clerks attest the line and sever the false roots from the foundry grid. Repairs after contact remain charged to the company.

nodes.name: Barrow Warrant
nodes.brief: Barrow Yard holds the master warrant, the counterfeit ledger and the local compact that kept the rebuild line alive. Secure the archive intact while the final attestation is made. What the Tender does with that proof will decide the Recall here.

nodes.name: Export Under Seal
nodes.brief: The Barrow archive supports the Continuance reading: every copied root remains Compact property under an unclosed custody chain. Take the disposition stand and hold it while the Tender seals the register for export. The reader will attest each machine, but the company must clear the nullity guard without destroying the proof it came to carry home.

nodes.name: Countersign Stewardship
nodes.brief: Barrow's compact also supports a lawful local reading: a century of recorded service can be countersigned as stewardship rather than counterfeit possession. Take the disposition stand and hold it while the Tender records that countersignature. The reader can prove continuity, not ownership; clear the guard and leave the working roots under local custody.
